description: Fresh bounded TMA cache-control assembler probes on the current direct-class model; historical cache32 inputs are unavailable and are not replayed here.
replay: For each case, create an isolated directory, write source_text to case.ptx, and invoke replay_argv there; compare exit success with observed. source_sha256 covers source_text UTF-8 bytes.
notes: The formal PTX 9.3 grammar permits a written cache hint without a final policy, but PTXAS 13.3.73 rejected the tested hint-only forms.
PTXAS rejected im2col_absent_info_policy with a vector-expected diagnostic despite optional im2col information in the formal grammar.
Acceptance only establishes assembly for these exact source modules; no runtime cache effect was measured.
